On the other hand, we have seen an impact on profitability owing to an unprecedented rise in commodity prices and losses in the Company’s subsidiary in Brazil. We are focusing on transforming our business operations and driving cost optimisation across the value chain to improve profitability. Considering the strong order book and robust business outlook, the Board of Directors have recommended a dividend of 200% i.e. ` 4/- per equity share, in line with last year. We are fully prepared to manage the debt and interest costs by better management of working capital through efficient execution of projects, war room focus on collecting receivables, judicious use of foreign borrowing and innovative solutions with our banking partners. We continue to be very careful while allocating capital to maximise the returns to our stakeholders. We continue to optimise our capital expenditure, which remained at ~1% of our revenues.
